values.binNote: RampageBonusRatio=3 is the flat percent-per-stack in whole-percent units (3 == 3%, matches the wiki's 3%); RampageBonusDamagePerc's ad term (0.03) matches the per-100-bonus-AD scaling.

mechanics.claim: Rampage's damage is reduced to 60% against minions.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies, reduced to 60% against {{tip|minions}}

mechanics.claim: Hitting at least one enemy grants a stack of Rampage, refreshing the buff duration and stacking up to 3 times, each stack increasing damage and reducing cooldown.
mechanics.quote: If this damages an enemy, '''Hecarim''' gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Rampage'' for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damage and stacking up to 3 times.

mechanics.claim: At maximum stacks, damage is increased by up to 9% (plus scaling with bonus AD) and base cooldown is reduced by up to 2.25 seconds.
mechanics.quote: up to a 9% {{as|(+ 9% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} damage increase and a {{fd|2.25}}-second reduction of the '''base''' cooldown at maximum stacks.
